topic.title: Water Abstraction / Impoundment / Licence Compliance
topic.source_contract: water source and abstraction point, quantity and purpose, licence need and type, resource availability, environmental assessment, impoundment works, licence conditions, metering, returns, construction and operational compliance evidence

scope_guards: Pre-application advice is not treated as a licence.
Water availability mapping is not treated as an allocation of rights.
A licence application is not treated as a granted licence.
A granted licence is not treated as completed abstraction works.
Installed metering is not treated as compliant returns.
A nil return is not treated as non-operation without site evidence.
One compliant period is not treated as long-term licence compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact licence, works, metering, returns and inspection evidence.
